name: corporate-actions-v1
method: Compiled from official-domain web-search summaries made on 2026-10-22 (not fetched pages, and no bar data had been downloaded). Nothing here was taken from price data. Status values: 'official search summary' = an issuer, fund or exchange page (or the issuer's own SEC filing) as the search summarised it; 'likely' = a third-party filing or an absence of results; 'none found, unverified' = no targeted official search was made for this symbol, so the absence of an action is a belief, not a finding. Every entry must also be checked against the data vendor's own corporate-actions record and the overnight-ratio scan in server/strategy/readiness.js before results are trusted.
adjustmentPolicy: splits-v1 requires split-adjusted, NOT dividend-adjusted bars. Forward and reverse splits must therefore be adjusted (prices divided and volume multiplied by the cumulative ratio for bars before the first split-adjusted session). Cash dividends, ETF distributions and exchange offers are not adjusted, so ex-dividend drops stay in the bars by design.

actions.label: 4-for-1 forward split (stock dividend)
actions.firstAdjustedSessionStatus: likely (NVIDIA said split-adjusted trading was 'expected' to begin 2021-07-20; a 2026 third-party SEC filing says the split became effective before the open on 2021-07-20)
actions.note: Inside the warm-up period. Split-only adjustment: bars before 2021-07-20 are divided by 40 in price (4 x 10) and multiplied by 40 in volume once the 2024 split is included; this factor is arithmetic from the two ratios, not a vendor statement.

actions.label: 10-for-1 forward split
actions.firstAdjustedSessionStatus: likely (NVIDIA said split-adjusted trading was expected at the open on Monday 2024-06-10; the same 2026 third-party SEC filing confirms it)
actions.note: Inside the validation period. Bars from 2021-07-20 to 2024-06-07 are divided by 10 in price and multiplied by 10 in volume in a split-adjusted series.

XOM.notes: Research belief only (unverified): the Denbury (about November 2023) and Pioneer (all-stock, about May 2024) acquisitions need no price adjustment for XOM as the acquirer.

actions.label: Kenvue split-off: voluntary exchange offer (not a pro-rata spin-off)
actions.ratio: 8.0324 Kenvue shares per J&J share, proration 23.231832%
actions.note: A voluntary exchange offer works like a buyback for holders who do not tender, so a split-adjusted-only JNJ series should carry no factor here (research inference, unverified). Some vendors may still apply a spin-off factor: check the vendor's JNJ record and the overnight ratio around 2023-08-18 to 2023-08-23.

actions.label: J&J exchanged its remaining 182,329,550 Kenvue shares for its commercial paper
actions.note: JNJ shareholders received nothing; no JNJ price adjustment (research inference from J&J's own 10-K).

JNJ.notes: No JNJ stock split was searched for specifically: 'none found, unverified' for splits.

reviewedOvernightMoves.note: Owner-reviewed overnight moves that the readiness scan flagged as split-like but that are not splits (for example an earnings gap). Add { "date": "YYYY-MM-DD", "reason": "...", "reviewedBy": "...", "reviewedAt": "YYYY-MM-DD" } under the symbol; never add an entry without looking at the vendor's corporate-actions record.

VRT.reason: Earnings move, not a split: Vertiv reported Q4 2021 results and 2022 guidance before the open and fell 37% (close 19.57 on 2022-02-22, open 12.12, close 12.38; 45.3M shares against 3.1M the day before). Alpaca's corporate actions for VRT from 2021-07-01 to 2026-06-30 list 13 cash dividends and no split, spin-off or other share action (checked 2026-10-22), and its raw and split-adjusted daily bars for 2022-02-18 to 2022-02-25 are identical.
VRT.reviewedBy: owner (decision 2026-10-22); vendor record re-checked by Claude Code the same day
